text: The Patriots head into their Week 2 home opener against the Steelers at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, September 20 at 1 PM ET facing significant uncertainty on the offensive perimeter, as wide receiver A.J. Brown was placed on injured reserve this week due to a high ankle sprain suffered in Week 1, leaving him sidelined for a minimum of four games and forcing the Patriots to rely on secondary receiving options in what figures to be a critical chess match with Pittsburgh's defense. Meanwhile, Drake Maye and the Patriots will look to bounce back from their opening loss, though the young quarterback has found time away from football's difficulties this week—he and his wife, Ann Michael, donated to the Amazon classroom wish lists of more than 50 teachers and support specialists at Alfred Lima Sr. Elementary School in Providence, Rhode Island, a gesture that underscored his integration into the New England community. On the stadium front, Patriots owner Robert Kraft made headlines by having rapper Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's upcoming shows at Gillette Stadium, citing what he characterized as a "history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."
